MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub feels useful because it could connect the external drive, webcam, and card readers I already use; it supports my existing equipment.",
    "The wireless keyboard and Alexa devices fit my history of computer accessories and home entertainment purchases, so the connection to my interests makes sense even when I do not need another one now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Cube, Echo Dot with clock, and compact keyboard overlap with devices I recently bought. Familiar features do not give me a clear reason to replace or duplicate them.",
    "Buying Mac-compatible accessories does not mean I own an iPhone or need MagSafe charging, and buying a door alarm does not establish a need for indoor video monitoring.",
    "My storage purchases do not imply that I have a spare NVMe drive needing an enclosure or a continuous-recording device needing an endurance card. Those products solve needs I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated Alexa purchases seem to be treated as a reason to keep buying similar Alexa devices, even though my recent purchases already cover those uses.",
    "Broad connections such as computer accessories, Apple compatibility, storage, and home security seem to matter more than whether the particular product works with my equipment and serves a current purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent keyboard, Fire TV Stick, Echo Dot, and Echo Show purchases matter because they leave less reason to buy another device serving the same purpose.",
    "Accessories that help my existing devices work together are more compelling right now than additional standalone devices; that is why the powered hub stands out.",
    "For storage and charging accessories, I need a specific use and confirmed device compatibility before interest becomes a reason to buy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my electronics interests but give too little weight to what I recently bought and which accessories would fill a practical gap now."
}
